dynamic.description: Assigned by DHCP or router advertisements

checksums.description: Signed list of SHA-256 checksums that includes the archive

key.description: Name of a vendor signing key built into Racksail

name.description: The archive's name in the checksums list

flags.description: Feature flags such as vmx, svm, aes or avx2

vendor.description: GenuineIntel, AuthenticAMD or the arm64 implementer

group.description: Group allowed to read the key

transport.description: sata, nvme, usb, sas or virtio

name.description: Kernel name, such as sda or nvme0n1

transport.description: sata, nvme, usb, sas, virtio or scsi

name.description: Kernel name, such as sda or nvme0n1

content.description: The drop-in file; ignored when removing

action.description: What happens, for example install, open, start or write

contributor.description: Who added this effect when it wasn't the requested change itself

detail.description: Extra detail such as a version

target.description: What changes: a package, a port such as tcp/443, a unit or a path

type.description: What kind of change this is

mode.description: Permission bits in octal, such as 0755

gid.description: Group ID; chosen by the system when zero

members.description: The complete member list; left alone when absent

gid.description: Primary group ID; a group named after the user when zero

shell.description: Login shell; no login when empty

uid.description: User ID; chosen by the system when zero

value.description: The offending value, when it's safe to show

type.description: ether, loopback, bond, vlan, bridge, wireguard or other

iommu.description: An IOMMU is active, so devices can be passed through to VMs

nics.description: Network interfaces backed by a device

tpmVersion.description: Major version of the TPM, such as 2

files.description: File name to contents; names start with 50-racksail

code.description: Stable error code in the form <module>.<snake_case>

examples: The domain example.com is already used by another site.

instance.description: A URI reference for this occurrence

params.description: Values for the placeholders in the code's message

title.description: Short summary of the problem type

type.description: A URI reference for the problem type

limitBytes.description: Space limit in bytes; zero removes the limit

maxBytes.description: Fail when the file is larger; defaults to 16 MiB

recursive.description: Remove a directory with everything in it

changed.description: Whether anything changed, or in check mode would change

long.description: Run the long test, which takes hours

runtime.description: Don't keep the change across reboots

readOnly.description: Make the snapshot read-only, as backups and send need

label.description: Names the directory the snapshots go in, such as the ID of the change set they protect

paths.description: Paths a change is about to remove

changed.description: Whether anything changed, or in check mode would change

unprotected.description: Paths no snapshot covers, because they aren't on Btrfs

name.description: Name of the group, such as network

activeState.description: active, inactive, failed, activating, deactivating or reloading

unitFileState.description: enabled, disabled, static, masked or empty

system.description: A system account without password aging

content.description: The file's contents; empty when absent

mode.description: Permission bits in octal, such as 0644
